title: JavaScript testing with Jest
summary: Write focused Jest tests for Node modules and run them offline through the only approved verifier shape, npx --no-install jest on named test files.

provenance.notes: Constrained to this runtime's JS verifier: jest flags are limited to --runInBand and --ci, and every path must be a named test file.

inputs.name: behavior
inputs.description: Behavior to pin, as input and expected result.

inputs.name: test-file
inputs.description: The test file to add or extend.

outputs.name: tests
outputs.description: Jest tests for success, boundary and failure paths.

workflow.step: Read the module and the existing test file; match its structure, helper usage and naming.
workflow.check: The new tests sit in the existing describe blocks where they belong.

workflow.step: Write one test per behavior with a name stating the expected outcome; cover success, each boundary and each documented error.
workflow.check: Each test fails if its behavior is removed.

workflow.step: Assert exact values and thrown error messages or types; avoid snapshot assertions for logic.
Mock only the process boundary (network, clock, filesystem); never mock the unit under test.
workflow.check: Removing the implementation makes the test fail.

workflow.step: Run exactly npx --no-install jest [--runInBand|--ci] <test file>; whole-suite runs and other flags are not allowed.
workflow.check: The verifier names the test file explicitly.

constraints: Do not edit existing assertions to make a failing test pass.
No network access, no real timers longer than a second, no writes outside the repository.
Do not add jest configuration or setup files.

examples.title: Rejected promise
examples.situation: An async function rejects on bad input.
examples.guidance: await expect(fn(bad)).rejects.toThrow('exact message') alongside the success case.

verification: The scoped jest command exits 0 and the new tests fail against the previous implementation.
No config, snapshot or unrelated test file changed.

task.text: Add a jest test with describe and expect for the rejected promise in the test file.
Review the jest mock and spy usage; does the test file mock the unit under test?
Add a jest test with describe and expect.
